emptyStates.promptoscope: The Promptoscope is recalibrating. Mercury has not been blamed.

records.headline: Draft first. Check second.
records.body: Generative AI can make the draft. It cannot make the draft true. Check the claim against the original source before you use it.
records.audienceJob: Give a less-technical reader one bounded action that reinforces the difference between generation and verification.

recheckTriggers: The source claim enters correction, hold or retraction.

records.headline: Your prompt brought no guest list.
records.body: Today favours adding the context the tool cannot see: who this is for, what you need and the material it should use. It generates from learned patterns plus the request, material and context available now. Check the result before you trust it; the stars did not verify it.
records.audienceJob: Use the horoscope form to make one bounded context habit memorable without pretending astrology caused the result or promising a better answer.

recheckTriggers: The canonical generative-AI claim enters correction, hold or retraction.

records.headline: Make the follow-up do the remembering.
records.body: When your idea comes back wearing someone else's name, use the record—not a public accusation. In an approved AI tool, use only facts you may share and ask for a neutral recap: what you proposed, when, what was decided and who owns the next step. Check every line before sending.
records.audienceJob: Give a professional reader one calm way to restore context and create a useful record without implying AI can prove authorship or safely receive confidential workplace details.

recheckTriggers: The credited source becomes unavailable or materially changes.
Applicable workplace, privacy or responsible-AI guidance changes.
